input.free_text_description: This system is a messaging platform that serves Developer, Admin roles. The platform provides capabilities for contact, default contact, web api exception handler. Secondary concerns include microservices functionality.

user_stories.story: As a Developer, I want to interact with contact functionality, so that I can accomplish my contact-related tasks.
As a Developer, I want to use contact capabilities, so that I can perform essential business operations.
As a Developer, I want to use default contact capabilities, so that I can perform essential business operations.
As a Developer, I want to use web api exception handler capabilities, so that I can perform essential business operations.
As a Developer, I want to access the system through a well-defined interface, so that I can perform my tasks efficiently.
